comment: AeroSensei: route ESP32 air-quality telemetry from AWS IoT Core to the InfluxDB-writer Lambda. Create with: aws iot create-topic-rule --rule-name aerosensei_telemetry_to_influx --topic-rule-payload file://iot-rule.json
sql: SELECT sensor_id, site_id, site_name, pm1_0, pm2_5, pm4_0, pm10, nc0_5, timestamp_ns FROM 'aerosensei/telemetry/#'
